text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD#P-9876 -> service=inference-api-prod-us-east-1, symptom=~18% 5xx rate, threshold=10% for 2m, escalation_policy=Inference - Primary
PagerDuty: Triggered escalation policy 'Inference - Primary' - routed to primary oncall Samir P (pagerduty.com/incidents/P-9876) :rotating_light:
Samir P: hmm saw the alert. trying to ack but phone didn't vibrate. checking logs now
(90s pass) incident-bot: PagerDuty escalation: primary missed ack -> paging secondary Ashley K :phone:
PagerDuty: Escalation fired -> Ashley K paged (Secondary)
Ashley K: Acked. I'm on it. context?
Samir P: i've started tailing the runtime logs — large spike of 502/503 from model-runtime pods, appears coincident with a config push to model-ref v3.0-quantifier ~5m ago. I didn't get the page, sorry :wave:
Ashley K: got it. repro-ing locally via curl to api-green: 
```
curl -sS -D - https://inference.prod/api/health | head -n 20
# returning 502s intermittently
```
Ashley K: checking pod statuses - several model-runtime pods are OOM-killed and restarting. suspect quantized kernel regression causing memory blowup. kubectl output: 
```
kubectl get pods -n prod | grep model-runtime
model-runtime-0   CrashLoopBackOff   4/5 restarts
model-runtime-1   Running            1/3 restarts
```
Leah M: I'm getting auto-paged by manager escalation (severity increased). joining. what's the blast radius?
Ashley K: ingress shows errors across both us-east AZs; customers on enterprise tier are likely seeing degraded responses. estimated affected requests ~15-20rps -> ~3% of global traffic but high for targeted customers.
CS Ops: looping in CS for customer notifications. which tenants impacted? can we get a list? :eyes:
Ashley K: running query against logs to get tenant list: `select tenant_id, sum(errors) from prod.logs where service='inference' and status>=500 group by tenant_id order by sum(errors) desc limit 10` -> returning tenant_42, tenant_acme, tenant_mlteam84 (top offenders)
Samir P: I can try rollback to v2.1-quantifier which was stable. recommend rollback as fastest mitigation.
Ashley K: agreed. preparing rollback. deploying via internal deploy tool: 
```
./rdeploy rollback --service inference --env prod --to-tag v2.1-quantifier
# watching rollout
rdeploy status --service inference --env prod
```
incident-bot: PagerDuty note added: "Mitigation: rolling back model ref to v2.1-quantifier"
Ashley K: initiated rollback at 03:45 UTC. starting controlled drain of new connections and rolling pods one-by-one.
(120s) Ashley K: Observed error rate drop from ~18% -> ~6% after first 3 pods replaced. continuing rollout.
PagerDuty: Notification: Escalation policy 'Inference - Primary' has notified manager Leah M (auto-escalation due to severity).
Leah M: good mitigation plan. Ashley, keep me posted on SLO impact and if we need to widen rollback or cut traffic. CS Ops please prepare messages for tenant_42 and tenant_acme.
CS Ops: drafting message for affected tenants. will share in #customer-notifications for review. cc @legal if needed for enterprise notices.
Ashley K: rollout complete at 03:51 UTC. system metrics show 5xx down to ~1.8% over last 60s. latency back to baseline.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Ashley K (P-9876). status=acknowledged
Samir P: i'm back online and will take follow-up for the postmortem. looks like quantized kernel used slightly different memory layout causing rare OOM on certain batch sizes.
Leah M: thanks. tagging postmortem: owner Samir P, severity P2, impact: partial degradation for select enterprise tenants for ~12 minutes, mitigation=rollback to v2.1-quantifier.
Ashley K: handing off on-call to Samir in 15m. I'll stay available for questions.
oncall-bot: on-call handoff: Ashley K -> Samir P at 04:05 UTC :white_check_mark:
Samir P: will take it from here and write timeline. will include kernel regression analysis and proposed safeguards (canary window, memory-pressure tests, revert gating).
Leah M: good. log a task to Redwood Optimize team to add quantization memory checks to our pre-release suite.
CS Ops: sent tenant notifications at 03:58 UTC. replies coming in from tenant_42 exec: "Thanks for the quick response, keep us posted."
incident-bot: PagerDuty: incident P-9876 status -> resolved (monitoring). follow-up: postmortem assigned to Samir P.
Ashley K: thanks team. lessons: add PD phone vibration check to oncall runbook ;) :thumbsup:
Samir P: noted. will include missed-ack timing and recommend update to escalation window (increase primary ack window by 60s for night shifts).
Leah M: closing loop. great fast mitigation and clear handoff.
